title: Help With Moving
transcript:
Woman: Are you free Saturday? I'm moving into my new place and could use a hand.
Man: I've got a dentist appointment at ten, but I'm free after that.
Woman: That works. I've booked the truck from noon.
Man: Is it just boxes, or furniture too?
Woman: Mostly boxes. The couch is the only heavy thing, and my brother's coming for that.
Man: Good, because my back's still sore from the gym. I'll bring lunch, too.
Woman: You're the best. I'll text you the address.

questions.stem: Why does the woman say she "could use a hand"?
options: To explain that she hurt her hand
To ask the man for help
To offer to help the man move
questions.explanation: "Could use a hand" is a request for help with the move.

questions.stem: Why is the man glad that the woman's brother will move the couch?
options: He has never met the woman's brother.
He wants to leave early for the dentist.
He doesn't want to lift anything heavy right now.
He thinks the couch won't fit in the truck.
questions.explanation: He says his back is still sore, so he's relieved not to carry the heavy couch.
